name: splunk
description: Splunk integration via the management REST API (typically port 8089) — run oneshot SPL searches, dispatch and poll asynchronous search jobs, fetch job results, list and run saved searches, and list indexes. Authenticates with a static Splunk authentication token (JWT) sent as a Bearer header; an optional insecure-TLS toggle supports self-signed management certificates. All requests use output_mode=json.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Splunk SPL searches, jobs, saved searches, and indexes via the management REST API

fields.label: Management API URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the Splunk management API, including the management port (e.g. https://splunk.example.com:8089).

fields.label: Authentication Token
fields.helpText: A Splunk authentication token (JWT) created under Settings > Tokens. Token authentication must be enabled by an admin, and tokens expire and need rotation.

fields.label: Skip TLS Verification
fields.helpText: true to skip TLS verification for self-signed management certs

tools.name: splunk.oneshot_search
tools.description: Run an SPL search synchronously (oneshot) and return the results immediately. Best for quick queries that finish within the sandbox timeout.

query.description: SPL query (e.g. index=main error | stats count by host). 'search ' is prefixed automatically unless the query starts with a generating command (leading |).

earliestTime.description: Earliest event time (Splunk time modifier or ISO 8601, e.g. -24h@h)

latestTime.description: Latest event time (Splunk time modifier or ISO 8601, e.g. now)

tools.name: splunk.create_search_job
tools.description: Dispatch an SPL search as an asynchronous job and return its sid. Poll with splunk.get_job_status, then fetch output with splunk.get_job_results.

query.description: SPL query to run. 'search ' is prefixed automatically unless the query starts with a generating command (leading |).

earliestTime.description: Earliest event time (Splunk time modifier or ISO 8601, e.g. -24h@h)

latestTime.description: Latest event time (Splunk time modifier or ISO 8601, e.g. now)

tools.name: splunk.get_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of a search job by sid — dispatch state, completion progress, and event/result counts.

sid.description: Search job id returned by splunk.create_search_job or splunk.run_saved_search

tools.name: splunk.get_job_results
tools.description: Fetch the results of a completed search job by sid, with paging via count and offset.

sid.description: Search job id to fetch results for

tools.name: splunk.list_saved_searches
tools.description: List saved searches (reports/alerts) visible to the token's user — name, SPL, and cron schedule.

count.description: Max saved searches to return (default 30, max 100)

tools.name: splunk.run_saved_search
tools.description: Dispatch a saved search by name as an asynchronous job and return its sid.

name.description: Exact name of the saved search to dispatch

tools.name: splunk.list_indexes
tools.description: List indexes with total event count and current size on disk.
